title: Stage 4 Authoring Studio
owner_authorization: 2026-08-16: Stage 4 approved end to end; do not stop until live.
desired_outcome: An active administrator can create, arrange, preview, and publish a private family memory in a calm mobile-capable studio journey instead of navigating repetitive long-form pages.
risks: Accidental publication, data loss, or removal of an immutable published revision
Private photographs, captions, signed URLs, or video leaking outside active family/admin access
Breaking existing shared-admin, draft, publication, private-video, logout, or PWA behaviour
Making the editor less usable on a 375px viewport
non_negotiable_quality: Active-admin authorization, origin checks, RLS, private/no-store media handling, signed delivery, and immutable published revisions remain intact
Family-facing photographs remain contained with meaningful alt text and captions
Every illustration scene is selected explicitly by the editor; no random selection or inference from prose or photos
Save draft, preview, publish, unpublish, media order, cover, captions, and private video retain truthful states and confirmations
Desktop and 375px authoring paths are keyboard-accessible and reduced-motion safe
smallest_viable_approach: Restructure existing Admin content editing as a step-based studio flow while reusing current server actions, revision model, media actions, and preview route
Add one bounded visual_scene field to draft and immutable revision records so the editor can choose from the approved scene manifest
Render that selected scene on published Chapter surfaces, separate from documentary photography
Avoid new services, dependencies, public routes, AI inference, or changes to family authentication
non_goals: No new CMS or authoring provider
No random scene rotation, content inference, or access to private photo prose for scene selection
No change to Family passphrase, active-admin policy, media bucket privacy, PWA service-worker policy, or video provider

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Admin can create or edit a Story, Gallery, Letter, or Moment through a clear sequence: identity and context, story, media, scene, preview, then publication.
Admin explicitly chooses an approved visual scene for a memory; it persists in the private draft and immutable published revision, and an unmapped/unselected memory has no decorative scene.
Admin can attach/reorder media, set a cover, edit required alt text and optional captions, and use the existing private video path without leaking signed URLs.
Preview is a no-store private representation and publish/unpublish preserves existing immutable-revision and family visibility boundaries.
The live Authoring Studio works at desktop and 375px; verified family surfaces retain login, Leave/logout protection, contained photos, captions, and selected scenes.
No new dependencies, services, or monthly cost; database change is a forward-only migration with no broadened public grants or RLS policy.

verification_plan: Schema inspection and minimal forward-only migration application to the Pawpaw Supabase project
Focused source verification for editor input, scene persistence, revision snapshot, and family renderer
Type-check, lint, focused tests, production build, and migration advisors where available
Authenticated admin desktop and 375px create/edit/preview/publish proof plus family desktop and 375px live check
live_boundary: Stage 4 is not declared complete until the deployed authoring journey and the resulting family surface are visually and functionally checked.
